final_candidates.decision_summary: Proline at W17 should disrupt backbone geometry while eliminating a bulky aromatic packing interaction in the WY segment.
I33 lies in the central hydrophobic segment; introducing Asp is likely to create an unfavorable charge and impair core packing.
Y34D removes an aromatic side chain adjacent to I33 and inserts a charged residue into the central hydrophobic cluster, favoring substantial destabilization.

stop_reason.detail: The sequence-based ranking has converged, and additional unsupported reflection would be unlikely to improve candidate selection.

history.rationale: Replaces a bulky aromatic residue with a backbone-constraining proline, likely disrupting secondary structure and hydrophobic packing.
W17 lies in an aromatic-rich segment, and proline is likely to disrupt local backbone geometry as well as aromatic packing.
Introduces a charged acidic residue into the central hydrophobic-rich segment, creating a strong risk of core destabilization.
Introducing a charged Asp into the central hydrophobic stretch is a strong folding-disruption hypothesis.
Replaces a hydrophobic residue in the IYPVIVRF segment with a charged aspartate, likely impairing packing and folding.
V38 is part of the same central hydrophobic cluster, making an Asp substitution plausibly destabilizing.
Removes an aromatic side chain and introduces a negative charge within a hydrophobic sequence region.
Loss of an aromatic side chain plus charge insertion is disruptive, although F40 may be nearer a functional surface than the deepest core.
Aromatic-to-proline substitution may simultaneously disrupt local packing and backbone geometry.
Y18P could disrupt the aromatic segment, though proximity to G19 may mean this position already has local conformational flexibility.
Proline substitution at an aromatic position could disrupt a structured strand or turn and weaken hydrophobic interactions.
The surrounding glycine/serine-rich sequence suggests a flexible loop, lowering the likelihood that F48P globally unfolds the protein.
Proline near the C-terminal structured region may break local secondary structure and destabilize the compact protein.
L65P may disrupt C-terminal secondary structure, but terminal regions often tolerate mutations better than the protein core.
Introduces an unfavorable charge at the start of a strongly hydrophobic central segment.
I32D should perturb the central hydrophobic region, but adjacent G31 may indicate a boundary or turn that reduces burial certainty.
Hydrophobic-to-acidic substitution adjacent to the native P35 is likely to destabilize local packing.
V36 is hydrophobic and centrally located, but its adjacency to native P35 makes its structural context less certain.
Converts the terminal hydrophobic residue to an acidic residue, potentially weakening C-terminal packing, though terminal exposure may reduce the effect.
As the terminal residue, V68 is less constrained and an Asp substitution may be accommodated without major folding disruption.

rejection.reason: As the terminal residue, V68 is less constrained and an Asp substitution may be accommodated without major folding disruption.
